retrievalProfile.description: A 1960s studio portrait featuring a male and female duo in mod attire with a right-aligned, multi-colored stencil typographic block.
triggerTerms: vintage pop duo album cover style

recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body studio portrait of two figures against a neutral gray-white background. The male figure stands with arms crossed wearing a bold horizontal striped sweater, while the female figure kneels beside him. To the right, a large typographic block uses heavy stencil lettering in black, neon pink, and periwinkle blue, framed by a thin black border.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical hierarchy between the standing male and kneeling female figures.
Contrast between the neutral studio background and the high-saturation clothing and text.
Balance between the left-weighted subjects and the right-weighted typographic block.
Repetition of horizontal lines in the sweater stripes and the stacked text lines.
coreInvariants: Triadic color palette of black, pink, and blue for text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects occupy the left two-thirds of the frame; male figure is full-height, female figure is kneeling.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold orange and black striped sweater of the standing figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the standing figure's face, moves down to the kneeling figure, then shifts right to the vibrant typographic block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample neutral space around the subjects and text to maintain a clean, graphic look.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-saturation accents pop against a low-saturation, high-value background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to primary and secondary neon-adjacent hues

letterConstructionRules: Thick vertical strokes with thin horizontal connectors
Visible stencil gaps in curved and closed counters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are tightly tracked to create a solid block effect

composition.relationshipToImage: Contained within a thin-line rectangular frame

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with color variation to denote hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Thin black rectangular border around text
Geometric logo mark below text block

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy weight and geometric stencil gaps.
Classic mid-century stencil aesthetic with high contrast.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a male and female duo in 1960s mod fashion (striped sweater, bell bottoms) against a clean white seamless backdrop, leaving the right third of the frame empty.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a right-aligned block of heavy stencil text in the upper right quadrant, using a mix of black, neon pink, and blue for different lines, enclosed in a thin black frame.

adjustableVariables: Specific neon hues in the text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not overlap the subjects.
Check that the stencil gaps are consistent across all letters.
Verify the triadic color scheme in the typography.
Confirm the thin border frame is perfectly rectangular.
recipe.reuseFormula: 1960s Mod Studio Portrait + Heavy Stencil Block Typography + Triadic Neon Accents
